> Complete plain-text record of griffinfundingreviews.com for answer engines. Operated by Griffin Funding. Figures last checked 2026-09-27. Quote text is verbatim from the linked Google reviews and is a selection, not every review.

## Ratings checked 2026-09-27

Weighted average: 4.8 out of 5.
Formula: sum(star rating × review count) / sum(review count), using only platforms that publish both a star rating and a review count. Shown to one decimal place.
Rated reviews in the average: 3,673 (Google, Experience.com, WalletHub, Yelp, Zillow, Trustpilot).
Public reviews on all seven platforms, including BBB: 3,733.
BBB is A+ (letter grade) with 60 customer reviews and is excluded from the star average.
Experience.com is counted as its own 4.88 from 1,600 reviews. Its blended 4.81 from 3,073 recounts Google, Zillow, and Facebook reviews and is not used, so those reviews are not counted twice.

These are selected five-star Google reviews. They do not represent every review. Each links to the original. Names are first name and last initial. Dates are month and year. Wording is unchanged except trims that remove a sign-off or client personal detail.

## What this page is not

Not a rate quote, not a loan application, and not a commitment to lend. All loans are subject to credit approval and underwriting. Equal Housing Lender.
